description: A port set into the base of the skull, the first chrome anyone gets. Direct data-feed sharpens the wits that matter for splicing and cracking.

failure_messages.burnout: Something in the port cooks. The smell reaches you through the bone.
failure_messages.dead: The jack dies. The feed goes, and the quiet where it was is enormous.
failure_messages.fault: The jack shorts. For a second every word you know arrives at once and none of them are yours.
failure_messages.strain: The jack at the base of your skull goes warm, then hot, and the feed picks up a hum you can feel in your teeth.

name: Dermal Jack
